title: Lomachenko emerges as possible next opponent for unbeaten Suarez

blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines— The road to a world championship shot gets tougher for undefeated Filipino boxer Charly “King’s Warrior” Suarez (20-0, 13 KOs, 1 NC), who could face former three-division world champion Vasiliy Lomachenko (18-3, 12 KOs) of Ukraine in a possible title eliminator in 2027. Lomachenko himself revealed the possibility of facing Suarez as he outlined his plans for a much-anticipated comeback following his retirement in 2025.
